description_en: Retrieves all history records of an instance. A history record is generated each time a node is rerun
description_zh: 调用ListInstanceHistory，获取所有实例历史记录，任务重跑一次就会生成一条历史记录
name: ListInstanceHistory

parameters.help_en: The ID of the instance. You can call ListInstances to obtain the ID
parameters.help_zh: 实例的ID。您可以调用ListInstances获取
parameters.name: instance_id

parameters.help_en: The environment of the workspace. Valid values: PROD (production environment) and DEV (development environment). Default value: PROD
parameters.help_zh: 工作空间的环境，包括PROD（生产环境）和DEV（开发环境），默认获取PROD（生产环境）的实例数据
parameters.name: project_env
